approval_basis: User explicitly confirmed candidate Rule B after the metadata-only comparison and before any formal split or full-cohort model training.
immutability: This protocol must not be changed in response to later model performance. Any scientifically necessary change requires a new version, an explicit rationale, and a fresh pre-model audit.

excluded: explicit sagittal, coronal, reformatted, MPR, or MIP series
hard_eligibility.uncertainty_policy: Missing or ambiguous diagnostic or geometry evidence requires manual review and is not silently accepted or rejected.
hard_eligibility.convolution_kernel_policy: No whitelist. STANDARD is not required. B, L, DETAIL, and vendor-specific values are not interpreted as bone-only without explicit evidence.
hard_eligibility.slice_thickness_policy: No exact SliceThickness is required. In particular, 1.25 mm is not a hard condition.

rule_b.scope: Apply identically to every patient without reading label or collection.
rule_b.coverage_definition: ImagePositionPatient projection span on the Series axial normal, in millimetres.
rule_b.coverage_limit: Projection span is a technical extent estimate and does not prove full-lung anatomical coverage.
rule_b.candidate_step: Keep hard-eligible Series whose coverage is at least 95% of that patient's maximum hard-eligible coverage.
rule_b.equal_rank_policy: Manual confirmation required. Do not choose automatically.

forbidden_selection_inputs: model loss, accuracy, AUC, predictions, saliency, or other downstream results

conditional_requirements.selected_series_uid: Required only for SELECT_ONE_CANDIDATE or INCLUDE_REVIEW_SERIES; it must be one of the recorded candidate Series UIDs.
conditional_requirements.excluded_or_deferred_case: Must not contain a selected Series UID.

manual_decision_requirements.reason_policy: The reason must describe diagnostic suitability, anatomical coverage, reconstruction characteristics, artifacts, or another reviewable imaging fact. UID, collection, label, position in a list, or randomness is not a valid reason.

phase_boundary.next_action: Prepare and review the unresolved Series cases, then wait for explicit confirmation of the final cohort.
